decisions: Unified Affinity is counted once, not as the retired separate v2 product trio.
Microsoft 365 desktop applications are counted as one suite.
Workstation Pro and Fusion Pro are one family record with explicit host differences.
Tableau Desktop Free Edition is current, but its workbook sharing and Cloud/Server restrictions remain explicit.
Time-limited trials are not classified as permanent free software.
Pricing describes the model rather than unstable currency-specific checkout amounts.
Product marketing superlatives are not imported as benchmark claims.

corrections: Tableau Free Edition client-output and cross-user content restrictions are explicit.
Power Automate Free local-attended entitlement is directly sourced.
Parallels current Apple-silicon build and Desktop 26 Intel route are distinguished.
